description: Land Acquisition - Rangallepola and Kuragamuwa, Narammala D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific parcels of land being acquired by the state for public purposes. It includes descriptions of land lots, their names, uses, claimants, and extents. This fits perfectly within the "Land Gazettes" category (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property-related matters.
